notes.title: 🏆 FINALISTS! 🏆
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44656949/c71975a2903110f8246e61368fb2f0e889872847.jpg[/img]

Honored to be finalists at the 2024 AGDAs!

Its a huge achievement and testament to the caliber of the game and the team. We took a lot of risks with the game creatively and I don’t think we knew exactly where it would land so this recognition honestly means the world to us. I want to thank the entire team that worked on Pond Scum. Every line of code, every asset, and every late-night brought us here. Ben, Rahn, Craig, James, Ben (2), Nic, Emily, all of our Translators! Pluto, Coffee, and mum.

We had a great time at the Forum in Melbourne and hope to be back there again soon!

notes.title: Pond Scum Original Soundtrack is out now on all streaming platforms!
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce that you can now vibe to the immaculate tunes of Pond Scum on your favourite streaming platform. This eclectic album sees Snappy the Caiman journey through ambient jungle, techno, psybient, witch house and even the masterful classical music of Ben Nicholls, as he pushes deeper and deeper into the Deep Swamp.

UWU is super proud of the soundtrack we produced for Pond Scum, and we hope you like it too! 🐊

The Pond Scum Original Soundtrack is out now on:
